0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) host the Los Angeles Lakers (8-2, 1st in the Pacific, 3rd in the West), with Atlanta riding a four-game winning streak and a 3-2 home record. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), who are all out, while Asa Newell (toe) and Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Los Angeles is without Luka Doncic (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the most recent meeting was a 141-116 Lakers win in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
